ensemble.note: round-4 shared rules (common/fullrun.js, criteria.js): 48 cases (FULLRUN_CASES_R4); avail = mean over the 48 cases of the riding-mask share with bodyPx ≥300 and no product part ≥2 px wide over the subject (artefactCounts) (refused/no-fly runs count 0); headClear vs helmetAt(sk, t); jitter = p90 over flown cases of footageStability(R).subjectRms; setupTime p90 (simulated: arm tap + wait to stowed at every stop, incl. reeling/walking and hand time); ops p90 (max reported); bodyForcePeak = max of the raw 50 ms moving mean at the integration step; keMax = max (ground frame >1.5 m from every body capsule, rider frame within; every non-docked sample); endurance from each run's mean power (heater over the whole day); headClear = min over the ensemble; line heights 1 m / 2 m behind the pack (min, p10)

independent.method: avail over simulateRun col.riding from t = 0 with bodyPx ≥300 and artefact width <2 px (shared rule) per sample; headClear = min distance of helmetAt(raw run, t) to the line boom-tip→KCU and to the KCU (canopy-disc term omitted, so it can only be ≥ the claimed value); F = max of the raw 50 ms tension mean column; KE = kite KE, ground frame when the KCU is >1.5 m from every body capsule (analysis bodyDist), rider frame within, every non-docked sample; ops = 1 arm tap + manual pick-ups/hand stows from the event log; setup = 2 s + wait from each standstill to the stowed event (mid-run stops beyond the rest)

clothesline.metric: height above the snow of the boom + line 1, 2 and 3 m (horizontal) behind the boom pivot, every airborne riding sample; lowShare = % of those samples with the lowest of the three below 1.8 m
clothesline.target: ≥1.8 m everywhere 1–3 m behind (adult neck/face height, ASSUMED gate from the brief)
clothesline.verdict: FAIL: the line/boom is below 1.8 m within 3 m behind the rider for most of the filming time; no exit geometry can hold a ≥1.8 m line near the rider without a rigid member that resists T·Δh (8–14 N·m) and is then ≥2 px wide in the shot

crossingSkier.scenario: neighbour crosses 0.35 m behind at 8 m/s (cross: helmet top 1.9 m; crosspole: pole raised to 2.3 m)
crossingSkier.mechanism: rear radar (4 m, 0.2 s) drops the reel drag to 1.5 N and the kite climbs; a line contact is detected in 60 ms and the solenoid holds free-spool; the 25 g boom is on a free pivot with a 5 N magnetic breakaway (effective struck mass ≤25 g)

closedForm.holdingFiveNewtonsOnSoftWing: at L/D 0.6 a soft wing sits at α≈55–60° with CR≈0.9–1.25 (TN D-4182/D-4672): pull = q·S·CR → 0.32 m² gives 21–29 N at 12 m/s and 47–65 N at 18 m/s unless the AREA is reduced
